# laptop-tune

> Comprehensive Rust utility for Linux laptop power management, hybrid GPU power-down, and battery optimization.

laptop-tune audits and dynamically tunes CPU energy performance preferences, GPU runtime D3cold sleep states, PCIe ASPM, thermal limits, and battery charge thresholds on modern Linux laptops.

## Architecture & Stack
- Language: Rust 2021 edition (high reliability, zero runtime garbage collection)
- GUI & Tray: `egui` lightweight native desktop interface with system tray daemon
- Hardware Interaction: Direct Linux kernel `sysfs` manipulation, ACPI `platform_profile`, and `udev` monitoring
- Supported Hardware: Intel, AMD, and NVIDIA hybrid graphics laptops

## Core Capabilities
- `laptop-tune status`: Real-time inspection of battery discharge rate in Watts, GPU state, CPU profile, and thermals
- `laptop-tune profile <eco|balanced|performance|max>`: Instant profile activation adjusting governors and EPP
- `laptop-tune thresholds <start> <stop>`: Protect battery longevity by configuring charge stopping thresholds (e.g., 50% / 80%)
- `laptop-tune daemon`: Event-driven background daemon responding to AC adapter plug/unplug events instantly
- `laptop-tune gui`: Native desktop control panel

## Key Files
- `src/main.rs`: CLI command router and daemon lifecycle
- `src/sysfs/`: Linux kernel power management controllers
- `src/gui/`: Native desktop application and system tray integration
